summary: A 20-foot treated timber R-6 lookout on Olympic National Forest land, built about 1957 and gone by 1972; four concrete footings remain on the summit.

facts.status_note: Tower removed or destroyed in 1972; four concrete footings remain on the summit.

access.note: Reached by Forest Service Road 2204, about 8.5 miles up Donkey Creek Road from Highway 101. A tank trap blocked the road to the summit area in 2017; no later report found.

visit.trail_note: Walk up the main road to just below the summit; the last stretch is an abandoned road under logging debris.

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Olympic National Forest

events.note: Timber from the West Fork Humptulips drainage was sold to clear a site for a lookout, per a November 14, 1956 Port Angeles Evening News item quoted by Washington Lookouts.
Firetower.org and Firelookout.com date the tower to 1957; Washington Lookouts dates it to 1958.
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register as US 1161 on November 27, 2011.
Firetower.org and the Weebly list say removed; Firelookout.com and Washington Lookouts say destroyed.
Around 2015 a commercial thinning project treated the second-growth stand on the ridge.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firetower.org and Firelookout.com give 1957; Washington Lookouts gives 1958 and quotes a 1956 plan to have the station built by summer 1958. Both years are stated in the story.
Firetower.org and the Weebly list say removed in 1972; Firelookout.com and Washington Lookouts say destroyed in 1972. The year agrees; the verb does not.
The register coordinates (N 47° 23.756' W 123° 47.344') match the record's point. The other value in the conflict list was not checked.

sources.title: Chester Ridge Lookout Site, Former Fire Lookout Sites register

notes_for_editor: Built year (1957 vs 1958) and removed vs destroyed in 1972 are unresolved and stated in the story. No staffing dates found; Harner's stint at Chester Ridge is undated. The 2017 tank trap is the latest access report; current status unverified. The 20-foot figure is read as the tower's height. Washington Lookouts page does not give a visit date. Read budget used: 6 page reads, 0 WebSearch calls. Elevation (381 m) and the record's second coordinate were not checked.
